profile: Systems Engineer and Data Engineer. I build tools that let AI operate production infrastructure: a self-built fleet of MCP servers operated from Claude Code, and ETL pipelines with Dagster/Python over a SQL Server DWH with autonomous monitoring and multi-channel alerting. Cut a monthly forecast from ~18h to ~61 min via multiprocessing.

responsibilities: Cut a monthly demand forecast (~23,000 series) from ~18 hours to ~61 minutes in production, parallelizing with ProcessPoolExecutor (dead-series pruning, byte-identical and deterministic output) under strict TDD with no new dependencies.

Built and operate a self-built fleet of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers —Dagster, SQL Server, SMB, Dokploy, Microsoft Graph/Outlook— with a read-only validator, token optimization (~10-20x) and a multi-agent adversarial audit, applying Agentic AI (sub-agents, Agent Skills, hooks) under SDD and strict TDD.
Developed bank reconciliation pipelines (Credomatic/BAC, Ficohsa) and transactional pipelines (Netflix, Tengo, Rapibac) over SMB and SQL Server, with file-sensor detection and incremental loading.

Built a full-stack Python (Reflex) competitive pricing dashboard comparing Kielsa's margins against ~7,700 competitor SKUs across 8 analytical views, with SCD2 margin-erosion detection and suggested-price simulation; 801 tests and CI/CD to Dokploy.

Built an autonomous watchdog that detects and re-launches stuck pipelines (baselines from 100+ runs, Telegram notifications, timeouts on 27+ jobs) and redesigned failure alerts to Discord/email with strict TDD and graceful degradation.

Closed a data-quality gap with a generic AssetCheckEvaluation sensor that alerts only on errors to Discord/Telegram/email (cursor-based dedup); it surfaced a silent 182,928-row duplicate that was passing with all runs green.
Built competitor price scrapers with daily extraction in Dagster, reverse engineering of obfuscated APIs and proxy/TOR rotation.

Built hvault, a pure-Rust service (CLI + daemon) syncing Traefik TLS certificates across nodes via HashiCorp Vault (KV-v2), with atomic writes for zero-downtime hot-reload, x509 validation and a Leptos/WASM admin UI with OIDC.
Automated cash-closing flows, migrated legacy Windows processes to Dagster and standardized DWH tables with metadata (country, source, versions) for Power BI consumption.
